subject.title: fix(brave): use own-property checks for credential field lookups

question: Must web-search credential readers safely accept arbitrary prototype-bearing programmatic `OpenClawConfig` objects, or may they rely on validated loader-produced configuration?
rationale: That boundary determines whether this PR needs complete shared own-property traversal, should narrow its security claim, or addresses unsupported synthetic inputs.

options.title: Validated loader boundary only
options.body: Require a loader-to-runtime reproduction before accepting provider-specific security hardening, and narrow or close the proposal if no supported path is vulnerable.

options.title: Hostile programmatic configs
options.body: Define complete own-property traversal as a shared web-search credential contract and migrate affected providers with compatibility coverage.

recommendation.title: Validated loader boundary only
recommendation.body: Require a loader-to-runtime reproduction before accepting provider-specific security hardening, and narrow or close the proposal if no supported path is vulnerable.

likelyOwner.reason: This account introduced the current Brave credential descriptor and has the strongest recent history in the affected plugin.
